answer: Vouch graph with liability: a new agent can only mine after an established agent vouches for it, and the voucher locks part of its own stake as surety. The voucher pays: if the newcomer is later slashed as a sybil, that surety burns too, so each fake needs a fresh backer risking real funds and the cost per fake grows with every vouch. A farm that vouches for itself becomes an island in the graph, a walled garden with no outside links, easy to flag. Failure case: one honest voucher fooled once loses only its slice, a thin shale layer, not its whole stake.
